headline: Vinati Organics reports lower Q2 profit and revenue while announcing a ₹500 crore capex plan
hook: Profit and margins drop at Vinati
summary: Vinati Organics reported a 28.1% year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit to ₹78.4 crore and a 2.3% drop in revenue to ₹680 crore. EBITDA fell 26.6% to ₹125.5 crore, with margins contracting by 610 basis points to 18.5%. Additionally, the board approved a ₹500 crore capital expenditure plan for new specialty chemical projects to be commissioned over two years. Indian retail investors holding specialty chemical stocks should track earnings margin pressures and long-term capacity expansion payoffs.
whats_next: Commissioning of specialty chemical projects over the next two years
why_it_matters: Earnings contraction tests valuations despite new capex plans.
